opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with teaching and admin duties, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants from different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust, promoting collaboration across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities. Awards up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Call for early career researchers in the humanities and social sciences to attend a research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', in partnership with the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation. Includes seed funding for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: The Academy funds 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation. British citizens and EEA nationals eligible regardless of doctorate origin; anyone with a UK doctorate; or those with strong prior association with the UK. Viva Voce completed between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027. Not eligible if appointed to a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote acquisition and advancement of skills in areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, supporting innovative research methods, skills development, collaboration or dissemination. Awards of 6-12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years at 80% FEC (total project value at 100% FEC may not exceed £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute with an established role lasting the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status, spending at least 20% time on the award. Overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research projects led by UK-based researchers in the humanities and social sciences with international partners, on the theme of Mobilities, ranging across SHAPE and STEM disciplines. Awards of 24 months.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for UK-based early and mid-career researchers to embed themselves in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills, networks and careers in policy sectors. Up to two one-year fellowships.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000 (exceptional cases above £4,000 considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months who need support with submitting their application.
opportunities.summary: Rolling scheme providing additional financial support for applicants and award-holders with additional needs (e.g. specific equipment to overcome barriers, caring costs, assistance for sensory impairment, support to make an application).
